candidates.explanation: The skip is computed as page * limit instead of (page - 1) * limit. Pages are 1-based, so page 1 skips 10 users and starts at the 11th. With only 2 seeded users, page 1 skips both and returns an empty list. Page 2 skips 20 and starts at the 21st. The document (Mongo) repository correctly uses (page - 1) * limit.

fix.description: Use a zero-based offset: skip: (paginationOptions.page - 1) * paginationOptions.limit
